facts.text: I am thinking of making changes to my daily routine to reduce my environmental impact.
I want eco-friendly alternatives to traditional paper towels.
I am interested in eco-friendly personal care products.
I want brands that offer refillable or biodegradable packaging for shampoo and conditioner.
I have been switching to eco-friendly products for the past three months.
I replaced my old shampoo and conditioner with Acure eco-friendly, sulfate-free products.
I used a coupon code from Acure's website to get a discount on my first purchase.
I have been experimenting with making my own cleaning products at home using natural ingredients like baking soda, vinegar, and essential oils.
I have been using a lot of baking soda and vinegar in my DIY cleaning products.
I am trying to reduce my use of paper towels by using reusable cloth towels instead.
I switched to Seventh Generation laundry detergent.
I am loving the results from Seventh Generation laundry detergent.
I am thinking of reducing my use of single-use plastics, especially with my lunch and coffee habits.

events.text: Switched to eco-friendly shampoo and conditioner (Acure sulfate-free)
